'''Niano Organa''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] member of the [[House of Organa]]. He was the son of [[Duke]] [[Kayo Organa]] and Duchess [[Celly Organa]], and the adoptive cousin of [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|You know, my father says they never let you leave this planet. They don't want anybody to know about you because you're not one of us. You're not even a real Organa.|Niano Organa, to Leia Organa|audio=Niano-NotReal.flac|<ref name="Part I" />}}
Niano Organa was the son of [[Duke]] [[Kayo Organa]] and Duchess [[Celly Organa]], whose sister was [[Queen]] [[Breha Organa]] of [[Alderaan]]. He was also a cousin to [[Princess]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]], the adopted daughter of Queen Breha and [[Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa]].<ref name="Part I" />

[[File:LeiaNiano-KenobiPartI.png|thumb|left|250px|The cousins Leia and Niano Organa quarrelled at a family gathering on Alderaan.]]
During the [[Imperial Era]], Niano attended a gathering put together by the officials of the [[House of Organa]] on Alderaan. When his cousin, Leia thanked [[Y-O]] for serving her [[Foodstuff|food]], Niano mocked her for thanking a [[droid]], which he saw as a lower life form. He then said that due to Leia being adopted, she would never be a true Organa. Leia countered by saying that she knew Niano only sought his [[Parent|father's]] approval and was constantly trying to impress him. This upset Niano, who left Leia alone. Later, despite her father Bail's encouragement, she refused to apologize to Niano due to his hatred toward droids.<ref name="Part I" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You don't need manners when you're talking to a lower life form.|Niano Organa, to Leia Organa|audio=Niano-Lifeform.flac|<ref name="Part I" />}}
Niano Organa was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] who had [[Color|black]] [[hair]], brown [[eye]]s, and light skin. Organa displayed [[anti-droid sentiment]], believing it was unnecessary to show kindness toward droids, which he described as lower life forms. He also did not consider Leia a true member of the House of Organa because of her adoption status.<ref name="Part I" /> At his home he would often play [[Hologame]]s.<ref name="DoR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Niano Organa first appeared in the first episode of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'',<ref name="Part I" /> which premiered on [[May 26]], [[2022]].<ref name="Episode 1 Premiere">{{Twitter|obiwankenobi|status/1530019678562549760|''[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan Kenobi]]''|date=2022-05-27|quote=The time for #ObiWanKenobi has arrived…early. Start streaming the first two episodes on @DisneyPlus TONIGHT at 9PM PT.|archivedate=20220527053945}}</ref> While unnamed in the episode, the credits identified him as "Cousin Niano Organa" and as portrayed by [[Ian Inigo]].<ref name="Part I" />
